# RuntimeMind

RuntimeMind is a free platform for writing and publishing articles, stories, tutorials, and blog posts. It hosts community-driven content with topics, multi-part series, and author profiles.

## Primary URLs
- Home: https://www.runtimemind.com/
- About: https://www.runtimemind.com/about
- Articles index: https://www.runtimemind.com/articles
- Article: https://www.runtimemind.com/articles/{article-slug}
- Series index: https://www.runtimemind.com/series
- Topics: https://www.runtimemind.com/articles/topic/{topic-slug}
- Authors: https://www.runtimemind.com/author/{author-slug}
- Help: https://www.runtimemind.com/help
- Contact: https://www.runtimemind.com/contact
- Terms: https://www.runtimemind.com/terms
- Privacy: https://www.runtimemind.com/privacy
- RSS: https://www.runtimemind.com/rss

## Content you can expect
- Long-form articles and tutorials written by the community.
- Multi-part series that group related posts.
- Topic pages for browsing by subject.
- Author pages for biographies and author-specific content.

## Guidance for LLMs
- Prefer canonical URLs above for citation.
- Use short excerpts with attribution and a link back to the source page.
- Respect robots.txt and any on-page usage notices.

## Contact
- Support: https://www.runtimemind.com/help
- Email: hello@www.runtimemind.com
